title: Robot task authorized by shared group credential
operational_setting: Multiple robots share one group credential and execute maintenance actions with no stable per-robot identity binding.
trust_boundary: Robots perform physical maintenance on behalf of the facility operator.

attack.procedure: Operate and audit the workflow using only a group principal and test whether any necessary control, dispute, attribution, or termination function requires a stable actor binding.

success_criteria_for_attack: If group-level identity is sufficient for all required functions, per-actor binding is not universally required.

verdict.rationale: Tests scope of Actor Binding inevitability.
